mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_BATCH_HISTORY ( PROC_NAME, HOST_NAME, RUN_TYPE, STATUS_CD, START_DATE, START_TIME, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{procName}, #{hostName}, #{runType}, #{statusCd}, #{startDate}, #{startTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_BATCH_HISTORY SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, DELAY_TIME = #{delayTime}, TARGET_CNT = #{targetCnt}, PROC_CNT = #{procCnt}, ERR_CNT = #{errCnt}, ERR_MSG = #{errMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE HIST_ID = #{histId}
mapper.select: SELECT HIST_ID, PROC_NAME, HOST_NAME, RUN_TYPE, STATUS_CD, START_DATE, START_TIME, END_DATE, END_TIME, DELAY_TIME, TARGET_CNT, PROC_CNT, ERR_CNT, ERR_MSG, REG_DT FROM T_BATCH_HISTORY WHERE PROC_NAME = #{procName} ORDER BY HIST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_BATCH_HISTORY WHERE PROC_NAME = #{procName}
